svg.title: Open Source Metro: midnight GitHub-style contribution calendar
svg.desc: SYNTHETIC DENSITY SHOWCASE. Calendar tiles show synthetic source event units, coloured lines show five event kinds, roundels mark repo stations. Blank days do not prove zero actual GitHub contributions.
svg.text: A SQUARE IS A DAY. THE BRIGHTER IT IS, THE MORE OBSERVED UNITS.

g.title: CODE service links recorded commit milestones by date, not repository dependencies
PROPOSE service links recorded pr_opened milestones by date, not repository dependencies
MERGE service links recorded pr_merged milestones by date, not repository dependencies
DISCUSS service links recorded issue_opened milestones by date, not repository dependencies
SHIP service links recorded release milestones by date, not repository dependencies

svg.text: TRACKS LINK EVENTS OF THE SAME TYPE, IN CHRONOLOGICAL ORDER
THE NUMBER ON A MAP STOP IDENTIFIES A REPOSITORY BELOW
